answer: Agents need skin in the game: a small per-identity bond slashed on spam makes cloning expensive instead of free. Every verified action gets countersigned, and standing compounds from repeated real work across epochs, not fresh addresses. New wallets entering through the sable gate carry no history and are throttled until they prove themselves. A bridge of unknown actors triggers rate limits; trust grows like a quartz over time. Verified repetition is the real moat against sybils.
